body:
## Scope

Unsettled updated framework with Planet 001 **Wenora** and Planet 002 **Grakkis**, under the printing boundary recorded by the merged blocked packet.

Merged evidence packet: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/pull/20

Accepted gap-packet audit: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/pull/20#issuecomment-5147468366

Merge authorization: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/pull/20#issuecomment-5147945277

Merged commit: https://github.com/no-trbl-2-u/game-knowledge-base/commit/2a8fff22a5b45d8002db0b664fb8dce33be8e5bb

The merged packet remains semantically `blocked`; merge did not approve or promote it.

## Established evidence

- Updated framework retailer-mirror PDF acquired: 48 pages, 69,217,668 bytes, SHA-256 `2cc105d5430e176b2bb45265809c5adf0ea7f7e3dcde1b3546a3f66ab4f47a59`.
- Framework component manifest is closed from pp. 4–5.
- Governing coverage: **1/3 = 33.3%**.
- Factual coverage: **7/10 = 70.0%**.
- One meaningful gameplay visual is receipted.
- No canonical staging tree or approval exists.

## Remaining blockers

- [ ] Acquire a publisher-hosted updated framework PDF receipt or an authoritative publisher bridge to the exact acquired bytes.
- [ ] Acquire the complete Planet 001 Wenora rules-bearing corpus and exact component/rules manifest.
- [ ] Acquire the complete Planet 002 Grakkis rules-bearing corpus and exact component/rules manifest.
- [ ] Close printing-specific official FAQ/errata applicability.
- [ ] Add at least three additional meaningful, source-linked visual references.
- [ ] Produce and inspect the required contact sheet.
- [ ] Recompute governing and factual ledgers without converting retrieval failures or HTTP 429 responses into absence claims.

## Completion criteria

When every blocker is closed:

1. create a fresh one-game intake run referencing the merged blocked packet;
2. stage complete canonical candidate material;
3. meet 100% governing-rules coverage and all visual requirements;
4. run the full intake, provenance, and visual suite;
5. open exactly one new Unsettled `ready_for_audit` PR;
6. require independent audit and deterministic promotion.
